_readme: Evidence for the Nano Banana image family, read from Google's own documentation.
Two things in here are worth more than the numbers.
First, this family TYPES its references - object, character and style are separate
budgets rather than one pile. That is much closer to how CineBraid already thinks
about references than most models allow, and it is recorded as a capability even
though nothing compiles to it yet.
Second, every output carries a SynthID watermark. That is a production fact, not a
footnote: it ships in the frame, and a filmmaker choosing this model is choosing that.

identity.note: Four models with four marketing names and four API identifiers, none of which match the handle a provider uses. This family is the reason CineBraid identity is neither a display name nor a provider string.

capabilities.note: Fourteen images across all three types, which is the figure a provider surface independently reports.

capabilities.claim: Typed reference budget for gemini-3-pro-image in character-consistency mode.
Advanced text rendering for infographics, menus, diagrams and marketing assets.
Multi-turn conversational editing carried by previous_interaction_id.
Every generated image carries a SynthID watermark.
gemini-2.5-flash-image is legacy, with a documented transition to gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image.

notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: capabilities.flags.seed is false on the model. A provider surface exposes one; that stays on the surface.

notEstablished.status: not documented in what was read
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: capabilities.flags.mask is false, so a masked edit routes to GPT Image 2 instead.

notEstablished.status: not documented by Google; a provider reports 45,000 characters
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: constraints.maxPromptCharacters is null on the model and the provider figure stays on the offering.

notEstablished.claim: Prompting guidance in an evidence-recorded form.
notEstablished.status: Google publishes a prompting guide for this family; it was not read into this record
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: promptPolicy.state is not-established. A pack may not be written from a guide nobody has read.

conflicts.resolution: CineBraid identity is gemini-image/3.1-flash and neither string. Both are recorded where they belong.
